title: Business-led Mode Project Registration
description: IT Security's registration of a business-led project: the reference the framework derives assurance facts from and detects implementation drift against. Filled by hand until a registration tool exists, per docs/business-led/implementation-plan.md section 11.

capabilities.description: IT Security's explicit approval that the project may exhibit each capability; not a detection result. run-registration-conformance.py (WS4 phase 3) compares detected capabilities against this set.

operating_conditions.description: Conditions IT Security attached to the pathway, for example Amber conditions under which the business owner may proceed. Recorded and displayed, not interpreted by the framework beyond that.

allowlisted_instruction_surfaces.description: The exact project instruction-surface files (.claude/ rules, skills, agents, commands, hooks, settings, .mcp.json, non-managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md text) IT Security has reviewed and approved. Compared by assurance/run-verification.py's instruction_surface_audit.

integrity.description: The hash IT Security's tooling (or governance.py registration seal, until a tool exists) computes over the registration content above, so a later hand-edit is detectable.
